init.sh succeeded. Now docker compose up -d. That will build many images - could take a long time. Let's check components and whether there are prebuilt images. The compose builds locally. This might take very long. Let's start build in background with logging.

First check disk space and number of components.

action.command: df -h / | tail -1; nproc; free -h | head -2; ls components; du -sh components 2>/dev/null | tail -1
